---
name: Share your story / 讲讲你的故事
about: How has AI affected your job and life? / AI 怎样影响了你的工作和生活？
title: "[Story] "
---

Thank you for sharing. Chinese and English are both welcome.
谢谢你愿意分享，中文和英文均可。

This post will be public. Please remove private or confidential information.
这条留言会公开显示，请隐去个人隐私和不宜公开的信息。
公司名称和证明材料均可不填，也不必回答每个问题。

### What did you do? / 你原来做什么工作？


### What happened, and when? / 发生了什么，大概是什么时候？


### How was AI involved? / AI 与这次失业有什么关系？

如果方便，请区分公司的解释和你自己的判断。
If possible, distinguish what your employer said from your own assessment.


### How are you doing now? / 你现在过得怎么样？

例如：仍在求职、已找到新工作、自由职业、创业或休息中。
For example: job hunting, employed again, freelancing, starting a business,
or taking a break.


### Anything else you want to say? / 还有什么想说的？


### Public sources or supporting material (optional) / 公开来源或补充材料（可选）
